title: AI for Business
summary: Practical AI that saves your team real time — chosen, set up and made safe.
rateNote: AI work is usually quoted per project rather than by the hour, so you know the cost up front. Ask for a quote and we will talk it through first.
intro: Most small businesses are in one of two camps: paying for AI tools that nobody really uses, or steering clear because no one knows where to start. Both are expensive in their own way. We help you work out where AI genuinely saves time in your business, set it up properly, and make sure your team can actually use it.
body: We are not here to sell you the hype. Some jobs are perfect for AI and some are not, and we will tell you plainly which is which. Where it does fit, the savings are real — hours a week on quoting, email, reports and data entry are common. Crucially, we set it up so your commercial and customer data stays where it should.
points: Choosing the right tools for your business — Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini or Grok
Accounts, licences and rollout, including Claude Code and Claude Desktop for technical teams
Practical staff training so the tools are actually used, not just paid for
Automating repetitive work — quotes, email triage, reports, summarising documents, data entry
Connecting AI to the systems you already use, so it works with your data instead of guessing
Agent orchestration and self-hosted agents such as Hermes Agent and OpenClaw, running on your own infrastructure
Data protection and safety — what should never be pasted into a public chatbot, and how to avoid it

title: AI Help & Training
summary: What all the AI fuss is about — explained patiently, in plain English.
intro: AI is suddenly everywhere and it is genuinely hard to tell what is useful, what is hype, and what is a scam. We will sit down with you, explain it without jargon, and show you the parts that might actually make your life easier.
body: There are no silly questions here. Whether you are curious, sceptical, or worried about being caught out, we will go at your pace and be straight with you about what these tools can and cannot do — including when the honest answer is that you do not need them.
points: A friendly, jargon-free introduction to what AI can and cannot do
Setting up ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini on your computer, phone or tablet
Using it for real things — letters, forms, holiday planning, making sense of documents
Help with photos, recipes, hobbies and learning something new
Staying safe: what not to share, and how to spot AI-generated scams, fake voices and images
Honest advice on whether a paid subscription is worth it for you, or whether the free version is plenty

title: Business Network Services
summary: Secure, robust networks — designed, installed and maintained.
intro: We bring years of experience, technical expertise and modern solutions together to keep your network running at its best. Our work with firewall and switch technologies means your data is not just connected, but properly protected.
body: Whether your network sits on your premises, in the cloud, or across both, we understand the differences and tailor the design to suit you. We build secure, resilient network infrastructure that stands up to the demands placed on a modern business.

title: Business Web Services
summary: Websites, hosting and domains — set up properly and kept running.
intro: We provide web services designed to strengthen your online presence. Whether you are launching a first website or improving one you already have, we have the expertise to deliver it.
body: We can host your site on a platform that fits your needs, whether that is a self-hosted server or a cloud service, and we will look after the domains, certificates and backups that keep it online and secure.
points: Web server deployment, self-hosted or cloud

title: Cloud IT Services
summary: Azure, Microsoft 365 and AWS — planned, migrated and managed.
intro: We are cloud specialists working across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365 and AWS. We help businesses move to the cloud sensibly, at a pace that suits them, without disruption.
body: Moving to the cloud should reduce your costs and your worries, not add to them. We plan the migration properly, keep your data safe throughout, and make sure you understand what you are paying for afterwards.

title: Cyber Security
summary: Practical protection against real threats — not scare tactics.
intro: Security should be proportionate and understandable. We assess where you are genuinely exposed, fix what matters most first, and explain the risks in plain English so you can make informed decisions.
body: From firewalls and endpoint protection to staff awareness and backup testing, we focus on the measures that actually reduce your risk rather than selling you products you do not need.

title: Office 365 Business
summary: Microsoft 365 set up, migrated and running smoothly.
intro: Microsoft 365 gives small businesses enterprise-grade email, file storage and collaboration tools. We set it up correctly from the start so it is secure, licensed sensibly and easy for your team to use.
body: We handle migrations from older email systems, configure security settings that are often left at their weak defaults, and make sure your data is backed up rather than simply assumed to be safe.
points: Email migration with no loss of mail

title: Secure IT Disposal
summary: Old equipment removed, data destroyed, disposed of responsibly.
intro: Old computers and drives hold more data than most people realise. We make sure equipment leaving your business is wiped properly, disposed of responsibly, and documented so you have a record.
body: Deleting files is not the same as destroying data. We use recognised methods to make sure information cannot be recovered, and recycle hardware in line with environmental obligations.
points: Secure data erasure to recognised standards
Certificates of destruction for your records

title: Virtual Desktops
summary: Desktops your staff can reach securely from anywhere.
intro: Virtual desktops let your team work from any location while your data stays centrally controlled and backed up. They can simplify support and reduce what you spend on end-user hardware.
body: We design and deploy virtual desktop environments sized to your actual needs, and make sure performance is good enough that people genuinely want to use them.

title: Virtualisation Platforms
summary: Server virtualisation built for reliability and easy recovery.
intro: Virtualisation lets you run more workloads on less hardware, with far better resilience. We design, build and maintain virtualisation platforms that are straightforward to run and quick to recover.
body: We have deep experience with enterprise virtualisation and bring that same discipline to smaller environments — proper capacity planning, sensible backups, and recovery you have actually tested.
points: Build and migration of existing servers

title: PC Repair & Maintenance
summary: Slow, crashing or broken? We diagnose the real cause and fix it.
intro: Whether you are facing hardware faults, software problems, or a computer that has simply become painfully slow, we can help. We diagnose the actual cause rather than guessing, and tell you honestly whether a repair is worth it.
body: Problems with your computer are frustrating and disruptive. We work to get you back up and running quickly, explain what went wrong in plain English, and show you how to avoid it happening again.
points: Slow or freezing computers made usable again
Computers that will not start or keep crashing

title: New Device Setup
summary: New computer, phone or tablet set up properly — and your files moved across.
intro: A new device should be a pleasure, not a puzzle. We set everything up properly, move your files, photos and email across from the old one, and make sure it works the way you want before we leave.
body: We will also take the time to show you what has changed, so the new machine feels familiar rather than daunting.
points: New computers, laptops, phones and tablets
Files, photos and email transferred across
A walk-through so you know your way around

title: Home Networking
summary: Wi-Fi that reaches every room and stops dropping out.
intro: Poor Wi-Fi is one of the most common frustrations we are called out for. We find out why your connection is weak or unreliable and put in a fix that actually holds.
body: That might mean repositioning equipment, replacing an ageing router, or adding mesh units to cover the parts of your home that have never had a decent signal.
points: Wi-Fi drop-outs and weak signal resolved
Smart TVs, speakers and devices connected

title: Malware Removal
summary: Viruses and scam pop-ups removed, and protection put in place.
intro: If your computer is covered in pop-ups, behaving oddly, or showing alarming warnings, we can clean it up. We will also tell you honestly whether a warning you have seen is genuine or a scam.
body: Once your machine is clean, we put sensible protection in place and show you the signs to look out for, so you feel confident rather than anxious online.
points: Scam pop-ups and fake warnings dealt with

title: Data Recovery
summary: Lost photos, documents or files? We will try to get them back.
intro: From accidental deletions to failed drives, our data recovery work covers a wide range of situations. We use proven tools and techniques to recover what can be recovered.
body: We will always be straight with you about the chances of success before you commit to anything, and about whether specialist lab recovery would give you a better outcome.
points: Failing or failed hard drives and SSDs
Honest assessment of the likely outcome
Backups set up so it does not happen again

title: IT Training
summary: Patient one-to-one help so you can do it yourself next time.
intro: Sometimes you would rather learn than simply be fixed. We will sit with you and go through whatever you want to understand, at your pace, for as long as it takes.
body: There is no such thing as a silly question here. Whether it is email, video calls with family, online shopping and banking safely, or getting to grips with a new device, we will explain it clearly and without jargon.
points: One-to-one sessions in your own home
Getting comfortable with a new device
Notes to refer back to afterwards

title: Custom PCs
summary: A computer specified and built around what you actually need.
intro: Off-the-shelf computers are a compromise. We can specify and build a machine around what you genuinely need it for, whether that is everyday use, photo and video work, or gaming.
body: You get components chosen on merit rather than margin, a machine that is straightforward to upgrade later, and someone local to call if you ever need help with it.
points: Specified around your budget and use
Built, tested and delivered set up
